<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 276.0666, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of about 275.059 Da. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS accuracy is C₁₄H₁₃NO₅ (exact monoisotopic mass = 275.079 Da, within ~20 mDa of the observed value). This fits the required “CxHyOzX” format with X = N.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H13O5N</final_answer>
